headlines.description: Alex Smith threw a 12-yard touchdown pass to Delanie Walker late in the third quarter, and San Francisco held off the Seattle Seahawks 13-6 on Thursday night as the 49ers won their long-awaited division opener.
headlines.shortLinkText: Gore, 49ers grind out win against Seahawks

headlines.description: Matt Hasselbeck hit Nate Washington for a 15-yard touchdown with 1:03 left in leading the Tennessee Titans to a 35-34 win over the Buffalo Bills on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Hasselbeck TD pass helps Titans stun Bills late

headlines.description: Andrew Luck became the first Colts quarterback to run for two touchdowns in a game since 1988, leading Indianapolis past Cleveland 17-13 on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Luck's two TD runs help Colts edge Browns

events.name: Green Bay Packers at St. Louis Rams

headlines.description: Aaron Rodgers threw for 342 yards and three touchdowns, and the Green Bay Packers' depleted defense flourished on the road, handing the St. Louis Rams their first home loss with a 30-20 victory Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Rodgers has 3 TDs as Packers upend Rams

headlines.description: Adrian Peterson ran for 153 yards and a first-quarter touchdown, and the Minnesota Vikings survived an ugly second half to hang on and beat Arizona 21-14 Sunday to hand the Cardinals their third straight loss.
headlines.shortLinkText: Peterson, Harvin help Vikings hold off Cardinals

events.name: Washington Redskins at New York Giants

headlines.description: Eli Manning threw a 77-yard scoring pass to Victor Cruz with 1:13 to play and the New York Giants overcame a late touchdown by rookie sensation Robert Griffin III to defeat the Washington Redskins 27-23 on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Eli's TD to Cruz rescues Giants from Redskins

events.name: New Orleans Saints at Tampa Bay Buccaneers

headlines.description: Jonathan Vilma played for the first time while appealing a season-long suspension for his role in the Saints bounty program, and Drew Brees threw for 377 yards and four TDs to pace a 35-28 victory over the Tampa Bay Buccaneers on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Brees throws 4 TDs, Saints dodge Bucs late

headlines.description: Dan Bailey made a go-ahead 28-yard field goal with 3:25 remaining to help the Dallas Cowboys defeat the Carolina Panthers 19-14.
headlines.shortLinkText: Cowboys stymie Newton, rally to edge Panthers

headlines.description: Matt Schaub threw two touchdown passes, Arian Foster ran for two scores and the Houston Texans dominated a showdown of the AFC's two teams, routing the Baltimore Ravens 43-13 on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Texans trounce Ravens despite Suggs' return

headlines.description: Sebastian Janikowski kicked a 40-yard field goal after Cecil Shorts III fumbled on the opening possession of overtime and the Oakland Raiders rallied from 14 points down in the second half to beat the Jacksonville Jaguars 26-23 on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Raiders rally for OT victory on Janikowski's FG

events.name: New York Jets at New England Patriots

headlines.description: Rob Ninkovich recovered a fumble by Mark Sanchez after Stephen Gostkowski kicked a 48-yard field goal in overtime as the New England Patriots held on to beat the New York Jets 29-26 on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Patriots prevail in OT after Jets rally in 4th

headlines.description: Ben Roethlisberger threw one touchdown pass, and the Steelers overcame their injury-depleted running game to beat the Bengals 24-17 on Sunday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Big Ben leads depleted Steelers past Bengals

headlines.description: Jay Cutler shook off an apparent rib injury, Brian Urlacher made a key fumble recovery and the Chicago Bears won their fourth straight, beating the Detroit Lions 13-7 on Monday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Powered by defense, Bears maul Lions for win
